notes: Corrected: of men no longer sits on ἀνθρώποις. The of is licensed by the frame noun likeness rather than by the dative — a dative's own case is realized by to, unto or with — so rule 21's frame clause keeps it inside the participle's unit and the governed word stands as a bare men, on the model of ἀναμνήσει … τὰς ὁδούς μου → shall put you in remembrance of my ways. The competing reading is named in that unit's note.
Λυκαονιστί is headed on Lycaonia rather than on speech, speech being the supplied generic completion under rule 17's generic-noun clause, with rule 66's compound test agreeing.
Both variants here are underdetermined with base readings compatible with the ASV, so no rule 97 note is owed.
